audit.why: Even-to-favoured lane (54.43% over 5863 games): Sylas bullies the mana-starved melee 1-3, Fizz peaks at 6 and first item with Chum the Waters plus E untargetability, Sylas retakes at two items by baiting the hop. Content layer has it right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was blanket 'Skill' while packet and content agree on Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Skill/Fizz/Fizz/Sylas.
audit.why: Playful/Trickster is 16s at rank 1 and unreliable pre-4; his 6 (guaranteed shark plus dodge) and first item are his windows; two items later Sylas front-loads through it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Sylas, 4-5 to Fizz, 6 to Sylas with rewritten whys and ratings; row 3 correctly stays Skill. Content agrees — side-only edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes; the flagged missing interaction (Seastone Trident auto-reset as the burst tell) was absent from the full layer.
audit.why: Fizz E 16/14/12/10/8 (untargetable), Q 8s dash, W 7-3s auto-reset opener, R 120/100/80 at 1300 range — also a premium steal against Hijack's 80s. E untargetability eats Abduct mid-animation (stated in content).
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written in with the steal economics; bleed bullets replaced with the auto-reset tell and shield-timing facts.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Fizz is a mana-starved melee at 1 — your ranged Chain Lash poke and whirl autos go uncontested.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: At 2 the Abscond-Chain Lash trade punishes him before his E dodge is reliable.

edits.before: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W with passive whirls is the lane's best level-3 all-in nobody respects yet.
edits.after: Full kit: when he Urchin Strikes onto the wave, Abduct and burst him before his 16s E lets him hop out.

edits.before: Hijack online — your R is whatever his best button is. The lane's power budget just became a shared account.
edits.after: His 6 beats yours: Chum the Waters guarantees follow-up and the E hop eats your Abduct mid-animation.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: First item peaks his R-Q all-in — play waves and roams, not duels, while his shark is loaded.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Two items on, you burst first: bait the hop, Abduct the landing spot, and the stolen ult finishes him.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster (E): 16s at rank 1, 8s max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; bait it, then all-in the down window. - His Q is an 8s dash: spent on farming, he cannot escape your Abduct. - Chum the Waters is 120s and a premium 1300-range steal for your 80s Hijack.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His burst opens on Seastone Trident's auto-reset wind-up — step back on the wind-up, not the cast, and chain him after the hop.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Abscond's shield must eat the Urchin Strike-Trident opener — held back, his burst lands whole before your W heal can answer.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your combo with Playful / Trickster, then landing Chum the Waters for the guaranteed all-in at 6.

edits.before: Ahead, monopolize: brawl Fizz off every contact, steal the map's best button on cooldown, and flank fights with their own game plan.
edits.after: Ahead, starve him: deny last-hits so his 6 arrives underfed, poke the mana bar dry, and all-in whenever his 16s hop is down.

edits.before: You are whatever the enemy drafted best: steal the fight-flipper, flank with chains, and let W make their focus-fire a rounding error.
edits.after: Late, bait the hop before you spend: once the 8s E is down he has no defensive answer — Abduct the landing spot and burst him whole.

notes: Level chart: full layer blanket 'Skill' moved to match packet and content (Sylas x3 / Skill / Fizz x2 / Sylas) with rewritten whys and ratings; content already agreed so side-only edits. Missing interaction (Seastone Trident auto-reset burst tell) now covered in dosFull[1].d. Packet suspectName 'Urchin Strikes' is a false positive (verb form of the real Q name). Kit flag misfire: Fizz R carries a 'grounding' flag but Chum the Waters' description mentions no grounding — trusted the description, wrote nothing about grounding.
